Use white #FFFFFF, clean near-white #F7F7F5, charcoal #242424, secondary gray #716F6D, and a committed cinnabar/crimson #D9363E accent (selected controls, current step, one primary action). NO blue or cyan anywhere. No beige parchment, no serif, no gradients, no glows, no excessive enclosing cards, no tiny text, no fake charts, no advertising. Clear type scale, carefully aligned 20dp gutters, ample rhythm. Material-native controls, every touch target at least48dp relative to393dp screen width. A slim Android status bar 9:41 and system gesture inset. Persistent5-item bottom navigation with coherent outline icons and Chinese labels 首页 走势 选号 方案 彩报; 选号 active red. Four plain top method tabs 单选 组选 单选单 位选, 位选 selected with red underline. Header title "选号", secondary Tools icon with label "工具". A compact issue selector "第2026300期" and small "位选" method hint. The numbers are 48dp circular or very softly rounded outline chips in two rows of5, not a wall of large rectangular tiles. Only0 selected in red because currently editing tens.
